eLTAX System Maintenance — Service Suspension (September 2026 Reiwa 8)

The eLTAX (Local Tax Portal Site) system will undergo maintenance, and service will be suspended during the following period.

During the suspension, you will not be able to use eLTAX or eL-QR for electronic filing, electronic payment, or other local tax procedures. Please note this carefully.

We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

【Service Suspension Period】

September 19, 2026 (Saturday) 00:00 – September 24, 2026 (Thursday) 08:30 (estimated)

For details, please see the links and leaflet below.
